Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HK-type
Aquifer depth: below 111 m (within Layer 4, ρ = 581 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Drill through the resistive Layer 3 (3.03–111 m, likely compact/dry formation) and target the lower-resistivity zone beginning at ~111 m depth as the primary aquifer; log cuttings carefully through this transition to confirm water-bearing (weathered/fractured) material before finalizing well depth.

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: >111 m (top of Layer 4, low-resistivity zone, base not delineated by survey)
Recommendation: Target drilling below 111 m depth to intercept the low-resistivity (581 ohm-m) Layer 4, which likely represents the main water-bearing zone; ensure adequate casing through the resistive overburden (Layers 1–3, 0–111 m) to prevent borehole collapse and to isolate potential perched or less productive zones before reaching the target aquifer.

Station: Choba-LawnTennisField
Curve type: KHA
Aquifer depth: 18.37–38.73 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately low-resistivity saturated sand layer between approximately 18.4 m and 38.7 m depth for screen placement; confirm lithology with cuttings during drilling, as this zone is most likely the productive aquifer, while the underlying highly resistive layer (>70 m) may represent a less permeable or coarser unit requiring careful evaluation before completion.

Station: Choba-LawnTennisField
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 38.73 m – >71.78 m (Layers 4–5, high-resistivity sand sequence)
Recommendation: Case off the upper clayey/low-resistivity zone (18.37–38.73 m) to prevent collapse and cross-contamination, and position the well screen within the resistive sand interval below 38.73 m, drilling to at least 75–80 m to fully penetrate the productive aquifer.

Station: Odufor
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 17.04 m and below (Layer 4, resistivity 1345 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Case and seal the borehole through the upper resistive layers (0–17.04 m) to prevent cross-contamination, and target screen placement below 17.04 m where the resistivity drop indicates a saturated, productive sand/sandstone aquifer.
